mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (id, body, user_id, article_id, created_at) VALUES (#{comment.id}, #{comment.body}, #{comment.userId}, #{comment.articleId}, #{comment.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, body, user_id as userId, article_id as articleId, created_at as createdAt FROM comments WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND id = #{id}
